heated.name: Andrew 🌲 Alpine Lake
heated.text: Are you looking for games from the heart where no AI is used this next fest? Here’s Alpine Lake, a cozy innkeeper RPG. I love working on it at a manageable pace with traditional tools. I have immense respect for the craft and I wouldn’t trade the journey for anything.

heated.text: You’re not wrong, but beyond cozy games, everything feels purely extractive. AI lowers the bar for dynamic pricing, endless subscriptions, low-effort trash. Instead of making products to bring joy, systems are now optimized to wring maximum value from consumers and if it's not, it's endless ads.
